name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.SidePairing.isSafe_smul_sub
summary: Apply isSafe_of_exponents to zτ⁻¹(gx − x) and gy.

steps.claim: isSafe_of_exponents with w = zτ⁻¹(gx − x) ∈ kerWithExponents(S, i, o) (smul_sub_mem_kerWithExponents) and g·y = (gy − y) + y ∈ kerWithExponents(S', i, o') (smul_sub_mem_withExponents, the image of gy is 0): its first assertion is IsSafe(P, κ, zτ·zτ⁻¹(gx − x), gy).
steps.lean:
simpa using
  (P.isSafe_of_exponents hK (smul_sub_mem_kerWithExponents hx g) (add_mem
  ⟨smul_sub_mem_withExponents hy.1 g, by simp_all [kerWithExponents, k.galMonoid.smul_def]⟩ hy) H).1
